response.sql: WITH matched_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS relative_gap FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS average_rebate FROM matched_fees) SELECT m.orderslink, m.ordertune AS order_type, AVG(m.rebtotal) AS average_rebate, AVG(m.relative_gap) AS average_relative_gap, AVG(m.rebtotal) - b.average_rebate AS rebate_excess FROM matched_fees AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b GROUP BY m.orderslink, m.ordertune, b.average_rebate HAVING AVG(m.rebtotal) > b.average_rebate ORDER BY rebate_excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A zero or NULL fee rate gives an undefined relative gap, so that fee record is excluded from the relative-gap average.
